annotations.title: Go back to a checkpoint of a website builder draft

description: Use this when someone wants to undo changes to their website builder draft or go back to an earlier version of it. Returns the new checkpoint, which brings back every file as it was at the checkpoint named; the later ones stay in the history. Not for the settings of the public site.

checkpoint.description: The checkpoint to go back to, from list_website_checkpoints

name: restore_website_checkpoint

checkpoint.description: The new checkpoint holding the files as they were; null when they already were
